name: Villa O'Higgins: Altavista trail to Laguna El Loco and El Toro
note: Quiet out-and-back from the Mayer bridge past three viewpoints (2.3, 4, 5.5 km) to Laguna El Toro; marked to the third viewpoint; starts through a gate on private land (standard public route). Ask at the visitor centre.

name: Villa O'Higgins: Río Mosco valley, one night
note: Route towards the Mosco Glacier, camp at Camp Patagones. Reported damaged 2023/24, reopening unconfirmed. Register with Carabineros.

name: Cochrane: Laguna Tamanguito loop
note: Las Lengas up, Los Pumas down; likely overlaps catalogue 'tamango'.
